mentions.name: PackageXray
mentions.description: A website that scans NuGet package dependencies for known security issues: users paste their NuGet package references and receive email notifications if a package they use is found in a vulnerability database.
mentions.problem: Keeping track of whether the NuGet packages you depend on have known vulnerabilities requires manual checking; this service monitors them and alerts you by email.
mentions.audience: .NET/NuGet developers who want to know when their dependencies have known vulnerabilities
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working on a website where you can paste your NuGet package references and get notified by email if/when a package you’re using is found in a vulnerability database.

evidence.value: I’m working on a website where you can paste your NuGet package references and get notified by email if/when a package you’re using is found in a vulnerability database.
